title: Nourishing Spanish Pak Choi Stew
description: A comforting and creamy Spanish stew featuring baby pak choi, made with wholesome ingredients and tempered with dark chocolate for a rich flavor, all in a convenient mason jar.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the chopped baby pak choi and cook until wilted, about 3 minutes.
Melt the dark chocolate in a double boiler or in the microwave in 30-second increments, stirring between each interval.
In a large bowl, whisk together the chicken broth, coconut cream, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cooked pak choi mixture and melted chocolate to the bowl and stir to combine.
Transfer the stew to a mason jar and serve hot.
Garnish with additional smoked paprika if desired.
Let cool completely before refrigerating or freezing.
